description: a relative import that leaves the project is import-relative, and the message says code outside the project is reached only through buckets link

violations.message: Relative import "../../../../shared/format" leaves this project (it points at ../shared/format, outside the project folder). slopbuckets forbids relative imports, and code outside this project is reached only through `buckets link`: if that code is a slopbuckets project, run `buckets link add <name> <its project folder>` in root/log, then import its published .external files through its alias. Otherwise publish it as a package and declare it in package.json.
